top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rise by More Than 3%
top_signals.summary: Oil prices gained more than 3% and were heading for weekly gains on continued uncertainty over Middle East supplies, and as investors kept assessing how much diesel Russia could supply to the global markets.Brent crude futures were up $3.41, or 3.2%, at $109.34 at 12:41 p.m.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Metals Rebound as Sentiment Improves After Volatile Week
top_signals.summary: Metals — including copper, aluminum and zinc — rebounded after hotter-than-expected US inflation and a selloff in AI stocks rattled markets this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
top_signals.summary: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: 25 charged after drug ring used unsuspecting truckers to haul cocaine from California to Florida
top_signals.summary:
Operation Icebreaker exposed a drug trafficking network that moved cocaine from California through unsuspecting trucking companies. Authorities seized more than 45 kilograms of cocaine, while a suspected supplier reportedly claimed deliveries of up to 60 kilograms every 15 days.
